verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a structured query model for ad hoc analysis. Queries have up to six clauses (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, HAVING), relational span prefixes (root., parent., child., anyX.) and filters, breakdowns and calculations. Its docs refer to this as Honeycomb's query language, and data is indexed on every field and queryable without a predefined schema. missing for 10: evidence of a typed textual query syntax (it is mainly a Query Builder UI), detailed operator/function reference, independent hands-on corroboration of the query language specifically.
